submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, only the Fe-rich one (Fe0.62 Ni0.22 V0.16) gave a positive photocurrent: 1.5e-7 A under 2.4 eV light. Its XRD pattern is simple, with two strong reflections (Q 2.667 and 4.498). That fits an Fe-oxide-based phase that can absorb 2.4 eV photons. The Fe-V-rich and V-rich compositions had many-peak vanadate patterns and gave about zero photocurrent.

rejected.reason: FeVO4-like vanadate composition (Fe0.41 V0.41). Measured photocurrent was 0.0 A.
V-rich (V0.68). Measured photocurrent was -1e-8 A, meaning no photoanodic response.
